name: Nalpak
summary: Above the Wailing Caverns, Nalpak keeps watch from a cliff-cave. The tauren druid remains faithful to Naralex's vision and guards against the corruption below.

sections.title: Watcher Above the Caverns
sections.body: Nalpak watches from a hidden cave above the Wailing Caverns' mouth. He remains loyal to Naralex's vision while his master lies trapped in a corrupted slumber below. To hold back the spreading corruption, Nalpak asks passing adventurers to gather deviate hides for leather.

faq.answer: Nalpak waits in a cave high on the rock face, directly above the natural formation leading into the Wailing Caverns in the central Barrens.
Nalpak is a tauren druid and one of Naralex's Disciples. He watches for twisted creatures emerging from the caverns while Naralex seeks to restore the Barrens through the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why does Nalpak want deviate hides?
faq.answer: Nalpak wants to examine the hides of the deviate creatures infesting the Wailing Caverns. Though evil, he believes their unusual hides can serve leatherworkers well.

faq.q: What is Nalpak's relationship to Naralex?
faq.answer: Nalpak is a faithful student and follower of Naralex. As one of the druid's disciples, he supports Naralex's ambitious attempt to reawaken the springs of the Barrens.

angles.text: As a druid, Nalpak reminds you how perilous the Emerald Dream can be when darkness takes root in a ritual meant to restore the land.
As a tauren, you share Nalpak's devotion to healing Kalimdor's parched lands. He refuses to abandon the mission even after disaster strikes the dreamers.
